info.title: 知码本地服务 API — 设计契约，v0.2.0 尚未提供 HTTP 服务
info.description: Future local adapter contract. All endpoints are planned, not live. Core plugin currently uses in-process VS Code commands. Stable cursor pagination orders by (createdAt,id); tokens must bind filters. All resource lookups recheck project authorization. See API说明.md.

post.description: DESIGN ONLY: no HTTP server is implemented in v0.2.0. Capability disabled until host isolation is verified. JSON keyword args apply to explicit Python entryFunction only; otherwise run the code as a script. Never run via host shell. HTML uses restricted rendering, not a Python worker.

DESIGN ONLY: no HTTP server is implemented in v0.2.0. POST streaming via fetch reader, not native EventSource. Events: meta(requestId), delta(text), citation(Evidence), error(Error.error), done(finishReason). Send comment heartbeat every 15s; disconnect cancels work. No automatic replay or duplicate request on reconnect.

post.summary: Apply a user-reviewed fix via the host bridge
post.description: DESIGN ONLY: no HTTP server is implemented in v0.2.0. approvalId is issued only by the trusted review UI for this exact preview.
